nodes.label: Web UI
nodes.role: Next.js control-plane interface
constraints: Core app/ is replaced by the Cloud overlay; shared helpers belong in lib/.
lib/ must not import @/app/.

nodes.label: API router
nodes.role: Axum HTTP and WebSocket route composition
constraints: Routes use browser-origin and authentication middleware.
The agent job heartbeat route is authenticated and updates the lease and active deployment phase in one transaction.

nodes.label: Identity & apps
nodes.role: Device login, sessions, and persisted application records
constraints: First setup requires a control-plane password before device login.

nodes.label: Provider integration
nodes.role: GitHub repository inventory, inference, and webhooks
constraints: Repository access is scoped through the authenticated GitHub token.

nodes.label: Deployment orchestrator
nodes.role: Creates deployments, renews agent job leases, and applies transactional two-phase activation
constraints: Activation checks pending/current deployment and records a route generation before commit.
Heartbeat renews the claimed job only while its lease and claim token remain valid, then records the active deployment phase transactionally.

evidence.symbol: UPDATE deployments SET status=CASE WHEN $1='running' AND status<>'queued' THEN status ELSE $1 END,last_heartbeat_at=now()

nodes.label: Agent gateway
nodes.role: Authenticated agent registration, events, health targets, job claims, lease heartbeats, build completion, and completion
constraints: Agent-scoped paths are rate-limited separately.
Successful build completion validates the assigned artifact manifest, records the build, and enqueues a release job under capacity and pause fences.

nodes.label: Recovery & observability
nodes.role: Startup recovery, screenshot scheduling, and browser/health diagnostics
constraints: Screenshot orphan sweep is startup hygiene; recapture sweep is periodic.

nodes.label: Postgres
nodes.role: Persistent relational control-plane store
constraints: Production compose requires POSTGRES_PASSWORD supplied at initialization.

nodes.label: Agent job queue
nodes.role: Database-backed job creation, claiming, lease renewal, heartbeat, build completion, and completion
constraints: Job lease and deployment heartbeat are coordinated by the API.
Build completion releases capacity only after validating the artifact manifest and acquiring lifecycle locks.

evidence.symbol: UPDATE deployments SET status=CASE WHEN $1='running' AND status<>'queued' THEN status ELSE $1 END,last_heartbeat_at=now()

nodes.label: Agent runtime
nodes.role: Installed host agent that claims jobs, renews leases while executing them, and runs deployment and operations work
constraints: Runtime is invoked as a separate agent process, not inside the API.
Every claimed job sends an initial heartbeat and renews its five-minute lease; repeated renewal failures or cancellation stop execution before reassignment.

nodes.label: Local deploy engine
nodes.role: Builds/launches local deployments, validates health, and switches routes
constraints: Candidate activation must be prepared before its route is committed.

nodes.label: Remote build engine
nodes.role: Builds remotely, publishes OCI artifacts, and returns or consumes signed artifact manifests for release
constraints: Remote build and release use the assigned registry namespace; artifact publication is verified through the registry push and digest lookup.

nodes.label: Contracts
nodes.role: Shared wire types, artifact schema, compose model, and inference helpers
constraints: Wire data uses shared Rust types and validation helpers.

nodes.label: CLI
nodes.role: Interactive self-hosted installation, operation, update, and provider setup
constraints: Interactive provider credentials must not be stored in repository files.

nodes.label: Screenshotter
nodes.role: Playwright capture container with routed-request safeguards
constraints: Public address validation pins resolved address to avoid DNS-rebinding between validation and connection.

nodes.label: Docker engine
nodes.role: Compose-defined local container runtime topology
constraints: Compose connects API, registry, local agent, router, and web services.

nodes.label: Caddy router
nodes.role: HTTP entrypoint and per-app route snippet host
constraints: Routes are rendered by the agent and imported from the shared agent volume.

nodes.label: OCI registry
nodes.role: Internal image/artifact registry exposed at /v2
constraints: API uses an internal registry URL in Compose.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.role: OAuth/device-flow provider, repository source, and release CI publisher
constraints: Release builds publish tagged images and create a GitHub release.

nodes.label: Cloudflare
nodes.role: Optional tunnel and DNS provider integration
constraints: Cloudflare configuration is optional and requires provider credentials at runtime.

flows.name: First-run authentication
flows.trigger: A user starts GitHub device login from the Web UI after setup.
flows.step_details: Web UI starts the device flow; the API dispatches identity handling, which exchanges codes with GitHub.
flows.outcome: A signed session is established after the device flow succeeds.

flows.name: Repository inspection and app creation
flows.trigger: A user inspects a repository and submits the create-and-deploy form.
flows.step_details: Repository inspection uses provider integration and shared contracts; the submitted app form is persisted.
flows.outcome: A configured app record exists and can start deployment.

flows.name: Deployment and fenced activation
flows.trigger: A manual deploy request reaches the API.
flows.step_details: The orchestrator creates agent work and fenced database state; the agent sends lease heartbeats while deploying, then prepares and commits activation before writing Caddy routes.
flows.outcome: The candidate becomes current only after the API’s fenced prepare/commit protocol and live job lease succeed.

flows.name: Remote build and artifact release
flows.trigger: An agent runtime selects the remote build path.
flows.step_details: The agent builds and pushes OCI artifacts, returns a manifest to the API, and the API validates it before queueing a capacity-gated release job.
flows.outcome: A validated artifact manifest and release job are persisted; registry publication and digest lookup are verified.

flows.name: Health and screenshot diagnostics
flows.trigger: A user requests a screenshot/browser check or automated recovery schedules capture.
flows.step_details: Diagnostics enqueue screenshot work that the agent executes through the screenshotter.
flows.outcome: Captured diagnostic output can be reported through the control plane.
